properties.name: onInteractOutside
properties.description:
Callback fired when an outside interaction event completes,
which is either a `pointerup`, `mouseup`, or `touchend`
event, depending on the user's input device.

properties.name: interactOutsideBehavior
properties.description:
Interact outside behavior type.
`close`: Closes the element immediately.
`defer-otherwise-close`: Delegates the action to the parent element. If no parent is found, it closes the element.
`defer-otherwise-ignore`: Delegates the action to the parent element. If no parent is found, nothing is done.
`ignore`: Prevents the element from closing and also blocks the parent element from closing in response to an outside interaction.

properties.name: restoreScrollDelay
properties.description:
The delay in milliseconds before the scrollbar is restored after closing the
dialog. This is only applicable when using the `child` snippet for custom
transitions and `preventScroll` is `true`. You should set this to a value
greater than the transition duration to prevent content from shifting during
the transition.

properties.name: onEscapeKeydown
properties.description: Callback fired when escape is pressed.

properties.name: escapeKeydownBehavior
properties.description:
Escape behavior type.
`close`: Closes the element immediately.
`defer-otherwise-close`: Delegates the action to its parent component that has an
escape keydown handler. If no parent is found, it closes the element.
`defer-otherwise-ignore`: Delegates the action to the parent element. If no parent is found, nothing is done.
`ignore`: Prevents the element from closing and also blocks the parent element from closing in response to an escape key press.

properties.name: forceMount
properties.description: Whether to force mount the component.

properties.name: preventOverflowTextSelection
properties.description:
Passing `true` will prevent the overflow of text selection
outside the element, provided the element is the top layer.

properties.name: onOpenAutoFocus
properties.description:
Event handler called when auto-focusing on open.
Can be prevented.

properties.name: onCloseAutoFocus
properties.description:
Event handler called when auto-focusing on close.
Can be prevented.

properties.name: trapFocus
properties.description: Whether focus is trapped within the focus scope.

properties.name: forceMount
properties.description: Whether to force mount the component.

properties.name: to
properties.description: Where to portal the content to.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Disable portalling and render the component inline

properties.name: children
properties.description: The children content to render within the portal.

properties.name: closeThreshold
properties.description:
Number between 0 and 1 that determines when the drawer should be closed.
Example: threshold of 0.5 would close the drawer if the user swiped for 50% of the height of the drawer or more.

properties.name: handleOnly
properties.description: When `true` only allows the drawer to be dragged by the `<Drawer.Handle />` component.

properties.name: dismissible
properties.description:
When `false` dragging, clicking outside, pressing esc, etc. will not close the drawer.
Use this in combination with the `open` prop, otherwise you won't be able to open/close the drawer.

properties.name: direction
properties.description: Direction of the drawer. Can be `top` or `bottom`, `left`, `right`.

properties.name: repositionInputs
properties.description:
When `true` Vaul will reposition inputs rather than scroll then into view if the keyboard is in the way.
Setting it to `false` will fall back to the default browser behavior.

properties.name: level
properties.description: The heading level of the dialog title.
